description: This file defines the ProductDetail component for a furniture shopping app using the LightningJS framework. It includes a template layout, state management, watchers, lifecycle methods, and event handlers related to displaying detailed information about a product.

classes.name: ProductDetail
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays detailed information about a product, including image, title, price, description, and an 'Add to Cart' button.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds the current product to the shopping cart in the AppStore.
